title: PolicyChangedData
description: data of policy.changed (PRD 9.5). The owner created, edited or revoked a policy, or used Stop all autopilot, which sets every policy to L1 (one event per policy). Revoking also sets the policy to L1, as if it did not exist: it authorises nothing and its next send waits at a gate (FR-HIL-03). level is the level after the change and is appended to the policy's history, so a send after a revocation or Stop all is never covered, even if the owner raises the level again later (outbox OB-01, BQ-31). Only the policy's owner creates and changes it (PRD 10.1; a Team Lead only proposes), so authz is by person and authz.ref is the owner of the policy policy_id names (event rule EV-04, validator); the history entry the change appends has that owner as by (outbox OB-01).
